text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан suffers a minor injury during
practice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Do you want to continue practice?

text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Do you want to continue practice?

text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Here, let's get you patched up.

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I can start again in just a second.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All something like this needs to heal is a
bit of
spit and—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Damn. And I'm already short on time.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: This is no time for resting!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Of course. I was never planning on
stopping.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: All right, at least let me patch you up.

text_block_list.text:
But as soon as you're done wrapping me
up, I'm
running. Got it?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
With her training cut short, Нарита Брайан
can't hide
her disappointment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems the proper treatment helped.
She
continues training after with no
issue.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан tries to continue despite her
injury,
but I gently convince her to pause
her training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
